text: Tilted slate slab: 'Here lies Picket Master Dorn, drowned holding the ford chain while the tax-wagons fled.'
Weathered limestone cross wedged in turnip-field mud; three fresh notches mark unnamed border levies.
Moss-choked headstone stamped with a parish debt-seal—the debtor's name was chiseled off after burial.
Cracked river-boulder inscribed in clumsy tallow-paint: 'Seven drovers lost in the fen fog, autumn thaw.'
Sunken granite marker beside the abbey wall, its carved prayers half-dissolved by rising black groundwater.
Tarred oak post at Sunken Ford: 'Toll: 1 copper per boot, 3 per axle. Clipped mint coins forfeited on sight.'
Charred plank nailed to a willow: 'Stay on the corded boards after dusk—the green lights do not lead home.'
Iron-banded notice outside Thornwick Market: 'Curfew at second bell. All scrap iron must bear the Bailiff's stamp.'
Slashed timber milepost: 'Alder Bridge, two leagues. Keep pikes lowered through the Greywood haulage defile.'
Lead plate bolted to an Undervault door: 'By First Compact decree, break no seal while spring melt runs high.'
Gout-worn stone warden staring south across the Alder rapids, his raised spear snapped off at the wrist.
Kneeling marble abbot in the Sunken Sanctum, green pond-scum ringing his folded hands like manacles.
Dwarven boundary pillar carved with intertwined drainage-channels; someone wedged iron spikes into its stone eyes.
Moss-bearded river-god bust half-buried in weir silt, holding a cracked stone jug that still trickles grey water.
Charred wooden effigy of a Border Magistrate hung upside-down from Ashbrook's ruined courtyard gate.
Pitch-sealed oak casket strapped with iron bands; faint scratching sounds stopped only when the lid warped.
Waterlogged pine box washed out of a fen barrow, spilling tarnished copper burial-tokens into the peat.
Lead-lined stone sarcophagus in the abbey crypt, its lid pried open with a broken quarry crowbar.
Shallow plank bier abandoned beside the turnip ditch, still smelling strongly of camphor and wet wool.
Iron-riveted debtor's casket stamped with Morvessa's wax seal; heavy chains lock the hasp from outside.
Flooded limestone altar draped in rotting linen; blackened tallow stubs ring a bowl of dark river-water.
Flat slate slab in Hexer's clearing, stained with dried sheep-blood and littered with knotted willow-twigs.
Dwarven oath-anvil wedged into Undervault masonry, its top grooved for pouring molten lead seals.
Roadside shrine to the River Watch; travelers have left bent nails and dry hardbread crusted with mold.
Cracked font inside Ravenwatch cellar, filled with frozen rainwater and three drowned messenger-ravens.
Iron-bound levy pay-chest with a smashed lock; nothing remains inside save clipped tin slugs and damp straw.
Tarred shipwright tool-box wedged beneath a Greywood wagon axle, packed with oiled saws and hemp twine.
Salt-stained apothecary coffer hidden behind cellar wine racks, clinking with stoppered herb phials.
Rusted toll-collector's strongbox fished from the eel-weir, crusted thick with river mussels and silt.
Oak archer's locker bolted to Ravenwatch's parapet, holding bundles of goose-fletched ash shafts.
Sun-bleached sandstone slab: 'Here rests Caravan Factor Bram's outrider—ambushed six paces from clean water.'
Cairn of red ironstone cobbles topped with a cracked water-skin; alkali wind has scoured the name clean.
Third-Dynasty stele carved with ledger-columns instead of prayers, listing grain debts owed to the dead.
Iron pickaxe driven upright into quarry scree beside a shallow grave; a miner's number-tag hangs from the haft.
Salt-encrusted limestone marker sinking crookedly into ochre clay at the edge of the Redmarsh border ditch.
Crooked driftwood board: 'Redmarsh Stockade—boil all water twice; leech-bite salve sold at the sutler's tent.'
Chiseled sandstone warning: 'Beware static discharge near the Quartz Plateau during dry desert squalls.'
Rusted iron plate above Deep Quarry: 'Abandon picks at the third horn—lower galleries flood without warning.'
Defaced imperial milestone whose southern mileage was hammered out and replaced with a Sand-Clan skull mark.
Painted timber board at Ironheart causeway: 'Water ration: one gill per watch. Wastage punishable by the lash.'
Weathered Third-Dynasty tax-judge carved in red sandstone, holding bronze balance-pans corroded green by salt.
Toppled desert-king colossus half-buried in Bracken Basin dunes; scorpion nests fill its hollow stone nostrils.
Black basalt miner figure outside the Deep Quarry pens, its carved iron lantern stained with rust streaks.
Wind-pitted sandstone hound flanking Ironheart's gate, its stone jaws choked with drifted red alkali grit.
Primeval quartz wardstone carved with spiral grounding grooves; violet sparks still snap across its split core.
Bitumen-coated cedar sarcophagus standing upright in a Redrock vault, sealed with stamped royal clay.
Sun-warped pine box tumbled from a mired supply wagon, spilling dried salt-pork and brass buttons.
Sandstone ossuary urn-chest bound with copper wire; dry, rattling hisses echo whenever dust blows past.
Rusted iron slave-bier chained to the third quarry terrace, stained dark with oil and limestone dust.
Painted Third-Dynasty mummy case cracked open by looters; natron salt and brittle linen litter the floor.
Ring of twelve black standing stones weeping bitter green brine into a sunken clay basin.
Sand-scoured caravan shrine piled with empty glass vials and snapped horn-bow strings left for safe passage.
Blood-warded obsidian table beside the ruptured monolith, still warm with residual static charge.
Dry stone cistern-altar inside Ironheart Bastion; prayers for rain are scratched deeply into its dusty rim.
Third-Dynasty embalming slab grooved to drain fluids into four carved sandstone jar-sockets.
Brass-cornered caravan strongbox bolted to a sunken wagon bed, sealed against alkali grit with mutton wax.
Heavy ironstone miner's tool-chest wedged behind quarry winches, holding steel wedges and tallow candles.
Sandstone reliquary coffer hidden behind a false vault brick, dusted with fine red canyon silt.
Reinforced stockade ammunition crate stamped with Redmarsh's whale-rib crest, half-empty of crossbow bolts.
Copper-lined scholar's specimen box left near the wardstone rupture, packed with insulated grounding tongs.
Salt-pitted granite anchor-stone: 'To the crew of the sloop Greywash—swallowed by the spring-tide bar.'
Slate headstone leaning in Oakhaven's lower churchyard, half-covered in dried ash from the Cinder Wards.
Cracked marble cenotaph inside the ruined chapel nave: 'Empty of bone, full of the names Vesperion burned.'
Driftwood cross lashed with tarred rope above the shingle spit, submerged twice daily by Atlantic surf.
Weathered guild monument by the drydocks listing forty shipwrights who died holding the culverin wall.
Tarred harbor post: 'Anchorage Tariff: one-tenth cargo in silver or whale-oil before the boom-chain drops.'
Brass plaque at Riverlock Crossing: 'Turn both capstans in unison—slack chains will snap the catwalk.'
Charred wooden board outside the Cinder Wards: 'Cleared by order of the Council. Looters shot without trial.'
Slate warning bolted to the Sunken Citadel stair: 'Beware high spring tide—lower barbican floods in twenty minutes.'
Painted tavern sign swinging on one rusted hinge: 'The Salted Keel—dry boots, hot broth, no Black Fleet coin.'
Petrified oak trunk carved into a civic guardian at Oakhaven's gate, hung with bronze guild curfew-bells.
Tilted First-Empire sea-king statue in the Sunken Citadel, kelp draped like a green beard across its crown.
Bronze lighthouse-keeper effigy overlooking Harborwatch mole, its outstretched lantern arm melted by fire-hulks.
Weathered stone gull perched atop the Split Tooth Crag, stained white with salt and black with signal-soot.
Half-submerged bedrock sentinel in the coastal scree, thick rune-seams visible beneath coats of red rust.
Tarred marine sea-chest pressed into service as a coffin after the moorland battle, nailed shut with copper spikes.
Barnacle-crusted stone sarcophagus exposed at low tide in the Sunken Citadel's flooded lower crypt.
Charred oak casket pulled from a burned Oakhaven chapel, its silver guild-handles melted into grey lumps.
Lead-sealed smuggling crate disguised as a funeral bier inside Baron Vane's catacomb hoist.
Weathered driftwood box wedged beneath the High-Orchard terraces, tangled in black gallows-tree roots.
Salt-stained limestone altar in the ruined chapel nave, currently serving as a surgeon's vinegar-and-saw table.
Copper-grounded Conclave workbench in Oakhaven tower, scorched with concentric arc-discharge rings.
Tidal shrine carved into a sea-stack; fishermen leave fish-hooks and tallow candles above the high-water line.
Desecrated bone-organ dais inside the drowned nave, littered with cracked femur-pipes and wet sheet music.
Blackened iron brazier on Harborwatch's seawall where gunners keep slow-matches glowing through sea mist.
Watertight bronze ship's strongbox salvaged from a grounded privateer hulk on the Greywash flats.
Pitch-caulked guild supply chest stacked behind Oakhaven's inner portcullis, stenciled with whale-oil marks.
Smashed smuggler's coffer beside Baron Vane's vault lift, spilling unstamped iron ingots and foreign gold.
Iron-strapped artillery locker on the sea-cliff battery, lined with damp wool to keep powder dry.
Salt-corroded reliquary chest wedged behind tilted pillars in the Sunken Citadel's upper lighthouse.
Scorched basalt slab: 'Here fell the Third Ironcamp Sapper Company—buried beneath the wall they refused to yield.'
Melted iron sword driven into volcanic ash; the crossguard bears the scratched names of twelve First Watchmen.
Cracked obsidian tablet beside the summit portal stairs, half-buried under drifting grey cinders.
Soot-blackened stone cairn at Three-Roads Watch, marking where three relief banners bled out in the ash.
Bronze memorial plate bolted to a caldera pillar: 'For those who starved in cold towers to keep the seals shut.'
Iron plate riveted outside Ironcamp: 'Wear smoked lenses at the fissures—star-iron glare blinds in heartbeats.'
Chiseled basalt warning at Magnetic Canyon: 'Unstrap steel scabbards—lodestone walls seize iron mid-draw.'
Scorched mile-marker on the Heartland highway: 'Crown of Order, twelve leagues. No mercy for turncoats.'
Stamped bronze plaque beside the Threshold Nave: 'Seven Anchor Seals hold the deep fire. Break none lightly.'
Tattered red pennant nailed to a trench traverse: 'Gauntlet of Iron—keep shields raised against enfilade bolts.'
Colossal headless king carved from black obsidian, staring sightlessly down at the Threshold crossroads.
Kneeling Penitent monk sculpted in grey pumice, iron chains draped across its bowed stone shoulders.
First Watch sentinel statue flanking the magma drawbridge, its meteoric spear glowing dull orange in the heat.
Cracked dragon-gargoyle perched on Greystone's sally-port, soot dripping from its open stone jaws.
Twelve conquered provincial monarchs carved into the Throne Colonnade, each bound with real iron collars.
Meteoric-iron sarcophagus riveted shut with caldera-quenched bolts, radiating dry, unsettling warmth.
Charred basalt ash-urn chest inside the Penitent cloister, sealed with grey wax and iron wire.
Warped bronze bier abandoned on the Ashveil summit stairs, stained with violet rift-sparks and soot.
Shattered obsidian casket beside the Obsidian Dais, its empty interior lined with scorched silver filigree.
Heavy slag-iron reliquary box chained to a Threshold pillar, humming faintly with bound warden-oaths.
Geometric basalt altar before the Threshold doors, split by twin channels of pale light and weeping magma.
Floor-fissure quenching anvil in Ironcamp, ringed with tongs, sulfur-brine tubs, and glowing slag ingots.
Penitent ash-brazier where blind archivists burn treasonous codices into grey, readable cinders.
Focusing pedestal on West Crag cradling a cracked violet prism that hums through boot-soles.
Scorched war-table inside Three-Roads Watch, covered in melted lead troop-markers and ash-dusted maps.
Sulfur-quenched steel armory chest in Ironcamp, stocked with meteoric billets and heat-proof gauntlets.
Asbestos-lined Conclave dispatch box dropped by Malrik's rearguard along the canyon switchbacks.
Heavy bronze First Watch supply coffer wedged behind a basalt buttress near the magma moat.
Soot-caked siege-sapper's locker inside Greystone sally-port, packed with quenching salts and iron wedges.
Gilded imperial treasury chest beside the Colonnade throne, locked with three interlocking star-iron wards.
